gen-dafont-joystix-gf-fauna-one: Chunky pixel-arcade lettering, spaced wide and nearly uniform in stroke. Fauna One follows in a serif with a tall middle band and short ascenders, so a long paragraph feels bookish and dignified.
gen-dafont-joystix-gf-hanuman: Joystix letters are tracked wide, with stems barely heavier than their arms. Hanuman, a classic serif with a high-waisted lowercase, gives that arcade swagger a refined, traditional counterweight underneath.
gen-dafont-joystix-gf-kadwa: Joystix spaces its arcade letters wide, with a tight gap below the ascenders. Kadwa's text serif has open-ended curves and a large x-height, and that sturdy editorial warmth is what the pair does best.
gen-dafont-joystix-gf-noticia-text: Loud, blocky, game-cabinet lettering with a faint hand-inked wobble in its lines. Noticia Text then settles things down, its serif lowercase filling most of the letter height, so paragraphs feel literary and dignified.
gen-dafont-joystix-gf-pridi: Refined is the body's mood, and Joystix plays against it with bold, widely tracked arcade capitals. Pridi, a classic serif with small letters standing almost capital-sized, lets those loud headings sit above text that stays polite.
gen-dafont-joystix-gf-scope-one: Traditional in spirit, Scope One is a text serif with a big x-height and stubby ascenders under Joystix's arcade heading. Its counters spill open, so long reading goes down easily.
gen-dafont-joystix-gf-slabo-13px: Bookish and dignified, Slabo 13px is a serif with large open counters, and Joystix above it brings widely tracked arcade lettering with soft heavier accents. Loud meets studious, yet they sit comfortably together.
gen-dafont-joystix-roboto-slab: Roboto Slab brings a precise, structured slab-serif texture where the middle zone dominates each line. Joystix does bold, widely tracked arcade display best, while Roboto Slab does open-throated, orderly text best.
gen-dafont-joystix-rubik: Soft and clean, Rubik is the plain sans here, with lowercase that looks big beside its capitals and round shapes that read clearly small. Joystix handles the bold arcade shouting; Rubik handles the talking.
gen-dafont-junegull-gf-epunda-slab: Retro and friendly, Junegull has pinched curves and cast-iron stature. Epunda Slab, a classic serif with a gaping c and tall rounded lowercase, makes a long stretch of text read dignified and wide open.
